hebrewText: וְ/הֵ֛מָּה מָר֥וּ וְ/עִצְּב֖וּ אֶת ר֣וּחַ קָדְשׁ֑/וֹ וַ/יֵּהָפֵ֥ךְ לָ/הֶ֛ם לְ/אוֹיֵ֖ב ה֥וּא נִלְחַם בָּֽ/ם

tokens.kjv: it, like, [idiom] (how, so) many (soever, more as) they (be), (the) same, [idiom] so, [idiom] such, their, them, these, they, those, which, who, whom, withal, ye.

tokens.bdb: to be (causatively, make) bitter (or unpleasant); (figuratively) to rebel (or resist; causatively, to provoke)
tokens.kjv: bitter, change, be disobedient, disobey, grievously, provocation, provoke(-ing), (be) rebel (against, -lious).

tokens.bdb: properly, to carve, i.e. fabricate or fashion; hence (in a bad sense) to worry, pain or anger
tokens.kjv: displease, grieve, hurt, make, be sorry, vex, worship, wrest.

tokens.bdb: properly, self (but generally used to point out more definitely the object of a verb or preposition, even or namely)
tokens.explanation: et — partícula de objeto direto, sem tradução literal em português

tokens.bdb: wind; by resemblance breath, i.e. a sensible (or even violent) exhalation; figuratively, life, anger, unsubstantiality; by extension, a region of the sky; by resemblance spirit, but only of a rational being (including its expression and functions)
tokens.kjv: air, anger, blast, breath, [idiom] cool, courage, mind, [idiom] quarter, [idiom] side, spirit(-ual), tempest, [idiom] vain, (whirl-) wind(-y).
tokens.explanation: ruach — espírito, vento, sopro, alento de vida

tokens.bdb: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract, sanctity
tokens.kjv: consecrated (thing), dedicated (thing), hallowed (thing), holiness, ([idiom] most) holy ([idiom] day, portion, thing), saint, sanctuary.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract
tokens.enLiteralWord: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract
tokens.explanation: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract
tokens.explanationEn: a sacred place or thing; rarely abstract

tokens.bdb: to turn about or over; by implication, to change, overturn, return, pervert
tokens.kjv: [idiom] become, change, come, be converted, give, make (a bed), overthrow (-turn), perverse, retire, tumble, turn (again, aside, back, to the contrary, every way).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to turn about or over; by implication
tokens.enLiteralWord: to turn about or over; by implication
tokens.explanation: to turn about or over; by implication
tokens.explanationEn: to turn about or over; by implication

tokens.bdb: he (she or it); only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also (intensively) self, or (especially with the article) the same; sometimes (as demonstrative) this or that; occasionally (instead of copula) as or are
tokens.kjv: he, as for her, him(-self), it, the same, she (herself), such, that (...it), these, they, this, those, which (is), who.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self
tokens.enLiteralWord: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self
tokens.explanation: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self
tokens.explanationEn: he ; only expressed when emphatic or without a verb; also  self

tokens.bdb: to feed on; figuratively, to consume; by implication, to battle (as destruction)
tokens.kjv: devour, eat, [idiom] ever, fight(-ing), overcome, prevail, (make) war(-ring).
